The source IP 10.0.5.14 referenced in the initial alert was a misattribution; forensic analysis confirmed the true source as 10.0.5.42. Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) include Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 traffic (ET TROJAN signature) to 198.51.100.23 over TCP/443 and suspicious rundll32 execution from the Temp directory. Lateral movement was attempted via SMB to 10.0.5.50 and Kerberos TGT requests. The service account svc_etl_prod was compromised and used in the attack chain, leading to successful revocation of its OAuth tokens and active sessions. The host WS-FIN-042 is highly critical (Finance department) and requires immediate isolation and forensic imaging.
